    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">

          <text>> 50</text>

          <text>"ManualReview"</text>

          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>

          <text></text>

    </decisionTable>
  </decision>

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 with no other rule matching

testSuite.name: ARMAllConditionsTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV below 80, credit score above 720 yields ARM7/1

testSuite.name: ARMBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720 meet inclusive limits

testSuite.name: ARMZeroHorizonMaxCredit
testSuite.description: Zero horizon and maximum credit score 900 still satisfy ARM conditions

testSuite.name: ARMHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds seven years, no rule applies

testSuite.name: ARMCreditJustBelowLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold and is not below 640, no rule applies

testSuite.name: ARMLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 85 fails ARM condition and is not above 95, no rule applies

testSuite.name: ARMVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition, no rule applies

testSuite.name: ManualReviewCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: ManualReviewDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: DtiExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, no rule applies

testSuite.name: ManualReviewLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: LtvExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, no rule applies

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and credit score below 640 both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview rule (creditScore below 640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: HighSensitivityAndHighLtvConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and LTV above 95 both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview rule (LTV above 95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: ArmConditionsWithHighDtiConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met but DTI above 50 also matches manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ARM7/1 rule and ManualReview rule (DTI above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: ArmConditionsWithFixedPreferenceConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but fixed preference is also set
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule and ARM7/1 rule both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: MissingCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Credit score missing while fixed preference is true
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null, so the ManualReview credit condition cannot be evaluated; rules do not say how missing values are handled. Fixed30 is the likely output.

testSuite.name: MissingLtvForArm
testSuite.description: LTV missing so ARM LTV condition cannot be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled, so ARM7/1 cannot be confirmed and no product may be assigned. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: AllFieldsNull
testSuite.description: Application with all decision inputs missing
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are null; rules do not state the outcome when values are missing. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: CashOutRefinanceArmEligible
testSuite.description: Purpose refinance_cash_out does not affect ARM eligibility; conditions met

testSuite.name: NoRuleAppliesMidRange
testSuite.description: Mid-range values match no rule

testSuite.name: ManualReviewCreditZero
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 triggers manual review

flaggedCases.note: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview rule (creditScore below 640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.
Fixed30 rule (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview rule (LTV above 95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.
ARM7/1 rule and ManualReview rule (DTI above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.
Fixed30 rule and ARM7/1 rule both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1.
creditScore is null, so the ManualReview credit condition cannot be evaluated; rules do not say how missing values are handled. Fixed30 is the likely output.
ltv is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled, so ARM7/1 cannot be confirmed and no product may be assigned. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview.
All decision inputs are null; rules do not state the outcome when values are missing. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_explicit
testSuite.description: Borrower explicitly prefers a fixed rate; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: arm_all_conditions_met
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score meet ARM criteria

testSuite.name: manual_review_low_credit_score
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: manual_review_high_dti
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 sends application to manual review; ARM criteria not met due to horizon

testSuite.name: manual_review_high_ltv
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: arm_boundary_horizon_7_ltv_80_credit_720
testSuite.description: All ARM boundary values are inclusive (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720)

testSuite.name: no_rule_credit_719_just_below_arm_threshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold and is not below 640, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: no_rule_credit_640_boundary
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so manual review is not triggered; ARM fails on credit score

testSuite.name: no_rule_ltv_95_boundary
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so manual review is not triggered

testSuite.name: no_rule_dti_50_boundary
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so manual review is not triggered

testSuite.name: conflict_high_rate_sensitivity_and_low_credit
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity high (Fixed30) and credit score below 640 (ManualReview) both match

testSuite.name: conflict_arm_and_high_dti
testSuite.description: ARM criteria met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review; both rules match and precedence is not stated

testSuite.name: conflict_fixed_preference_and_arm
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and all ARM criteria met; both rules match and precedence is not stated

testSuite.name: missing_ltv_and_no_collateral_for_arm
testSuite.description: LTV is null and cannot be derived because collateral and loan are missing, so ARM cannot be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R2 (ARM7/1) requires LTV<=80, but LTV is null and not derivable; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Most likely no rule applies, so expected is empty.

testSuite.name: conflict_high_sensitivity_with_arm_profile
testSuite.description: Strong ARM profile but rate sensitivity high triggers Fixed30; both rules match and precedence is not stated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30 for high rate sensitivity) and R2 (ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: arm_with_refinance_rate_term_purpose
testSuite.description: Purpose does not affect rules; ARM criteria met for refinance

testSuite.name: fixed_with_manual_conditions_only_fixed_applies

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both match because credit score is 650 (not below 640) and LTV 90 (not above 95) - actually only R1 matches here; no conflict. Expected Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTypical
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule applies; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndArmConditionsOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (Fixed30) and all ARM conditions met at once.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high) and ARM7/1 rule (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Most likely output: Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryLtvAndCreditExact
testSuite.description: ARM boundary: LTV exactly 80 and credit score exactly 720 with horizon 5 and stable income.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmBoundaryHorizonSevenYears
testSuite.description: ARM boundary: horizon exactly 7 years.

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveSevenYears
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the ARM limit; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreBelowArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below the ARM threshold of 720 and above the manual review threshold; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReviewLowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score 600 below 640 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC08_ManualReviewHighDti
testSuite.description: DTI 55 above 50 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiBoundaryExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_LtvBoundaryExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 is above 95 and triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC12_CreditScoreBoundaryExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC13_CreditScoreJustBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed rate preference with credit score 600 matches both Fixed30 and ManualReview.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview rule (creditScore < 640) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Most likely output: Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmConditionsAndHighDtiOverlap
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met but DTI 55 also triggers manual review.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ARM7/1 rule and ManualReview rule (dti > 50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Most likely output: ManualReview, since the rules describe it as a stop before automatic assignment.

testSuite.name: TC16_AllThreeRulesOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference, ARM conditions, and DTI above 50 all match at once.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30, ARM7/1 and ManualReview rules all match; the rules do not state precedence. Most likely output: Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC17_AllInputsNull
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null; no rule can be confirmed.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Missing values are not addressed by the rules. Null creditScore, horizonYears, incomeStability, etc. could mean no match; most likely output is no product.

testSuite.name: TC18_MediumRateSensitivityArmCase
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity does not trigger Fixed30; ARM conditions met.

testSuite.name: TC19_LowRateSensitivityVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM conditions and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC20_HighRateSensitivityNoOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity alone triggers Fixed30 while credit, LTV and horizon fail ARM conditions.

testSuite.name: TC21_LtvJustAboveEighty
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails the ARM LTV limit; no rule applies.

flaggedCases.note: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high) and ARM7/1 rule (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Most likely output: Fixed30.

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is the most likely output because it is the first rule written.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmVsManual_DtiConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI 55 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R2 (ARM7/1) and R3 (ManualReview) both apply; no stated precedence. ManualReview is the most likely output since the rules say manual review means no automatic assignment.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedVsArm_Conflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1) both apply; no stated precedence. Fixed30 is the most likely output because it is the first rule written.

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityVsLtvManual_Conflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity but LTV 97 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both apply; no stated precedence. Fixed30 is the most likely output because it is the first rule written.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; ARM requires >=720 and manual review requires <640, neither can be verified
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Empty result is assumed, but ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullDti
testSuite.description: DTI missing; manual review condition on DTI cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: dti is null; rules do not state how a missing value is handled. The rules have no DTI requirement for ARM, so the empty result is assumed, but DMN may compute DTI from raw fields.

testSuite.name: TC20_NullLtv
testSuite.description: LTV missing; ARM LTV condition cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; rules do not state whether it is computed from collateral or treated as missing. Empty result is assumed.

testSuite.name: TC21_MediumSensitivityNoFixed
testSuite.description: Medium sensitivity and no fixed preference, nothing applies

testSuite.name: TC22_FixedPreferenceCashOut
testSuite.description: Fixed preference on cash-out refinance triggers Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC23_ArmMinimumValues
testSuite.description: Zero horizon and zero LTV with maximum credit score meets ARM conditions

testSuite.name: TC24_LongHorizonNoRule
testSuite.description: Long horizon and high credit score, no fixed preference, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC25_ManualCreditAndDti
testSuite.description: Low credit score and DTI above 50 both trigger manual review

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else if not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) and application.collateral.appraisedValue > 0 then application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice = null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue)) * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else if not(application.income.grossMonthly = null) and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 then ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC23_MaxCreditScoreHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score 900 with high sensitivity and ARM conditions; both rules match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions) both match; rules do not state precedence. Fixed30 is assumed as the first listed rule.

newExpected.ambiguityNote: Both the ARM7/1 rule (horizon ≤ 7 years, stable income, LTV ≤ 80, credit score ≥ 720) and the ManualReview rule (DTI > 50) match. The rules do not state which takes precedence. ManualReview is the most likely output, but ARM7/1 is possible.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: TC02_FixedAndArmBothMatch
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and ARM conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high) and Rule 2 (ARM 7/1 conditions) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met exactly at boundaries (7 years, LTV 80, score 720)

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_ArmCreditScoreBelowLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_ArmVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_ManualReviewLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score 630 below 640 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReviewDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_ManualReviewLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndManualReviewBothMatch
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with low credit score matches both rules
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true) and Rule 3 (creditScore below 640) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedHighSensitivityAndManualReview
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with DTI above 50 matches both rules
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high) and Rule 3 (DTI above 50) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC16_ArmMediumSensitivityHighScore
testSuite.description: Only ARM conditions met with high credit score and short horizon

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingHorizonValue
testSuite.description: Horizon missing so ARM condition cannot be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 requires horizonYears of 7 or less; the rules do not state the outcome when horizonYears is null. Empty result is expected as the condition is not confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedFromRateSensitivityWithCashOut
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity on cash-out refinance, only Rule 1 matches

testSuite.name: TC19_ArmZeroHorizonPerfectScore
testSuite.description: Minimum horizon, minimum LTV, maximum credit score

testSuite.name: TC20_ManualReviewZeroCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 with low DTI triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC21_ManualReviewMaxDti
testSuite.description: DTI at maximum 300 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC22_NullFixedAndSensitivityNoRule
testSuite.description: Preference and sensitivity values are null, nothing else matches
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 depends on fixedPreference and rateSensitivity, both null; the rules do not state how null values are treated. Empty result is expected as no condition is confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC23_AllRatingsNullNoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score, LTV and DTI all null
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 3 conditions on creditScore, DTI and LTV cannot be evaluated when they are null; the rules do not state the outcome for missing values. Empty result is expected.

testSuite.name: TC24_HighSensitivityVariableIncomeLowCredit
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity high and credit score low both apply
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high) and Rule 3 (creditScore below 640) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScore639ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScore640Boundary
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIAboveLimitManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50; manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIExactlyFiftyNoManualReview

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVAboveLimitManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95; manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVExactlyNinetyFiveNoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndARMConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules for Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedAndManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity together with credit score below 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules for Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview (creditScore<640) both match; precedence not stated. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMAndManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules for ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) and ManualReview (DTI>50) both match; precedence not stated. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ARM7/1 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedAndDTIManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with DTI above 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules for Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview (DTI>50) both match; precedence not stated. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC19_FixedAndLTVManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with LTV above 95
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules for Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview (LTV>95) both match; precedence not stated. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC20_RefinanceCashOutHighSensitivity

testSuite.name: TC21_ZeroEdgeValuesManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score zero triggers manual review; ARM not met because credit score is below 720

testSuite.name: TC22_MaxCreditScoreARMEdge
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score 900 and zero horizon with stable income and low LTV

testSuite.name: TC23_MissingCreditScoreWithFixedPreference

testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null, so the ManualReview condition (creditScore<640) cannot be evaluated; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Fixed30 is the most likely output since fixedPreference is true.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">

          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">

        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

          <text><= 7</text>

          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies while credit score 600 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndARMConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and all ARM conditions are met simultaneously
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC16_ARMAndManualDTIConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI 55 exceeds 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) and Rule 3 (DTI > 50 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with low credit score and high DTI
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (creditScore < 640 or DTI > 50 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC18_LTVDerivedFromAppraisal
testSuite.description: LTV is null; computed from loan 240000 over appraised value 295000 (81.36%) so ARM fails on LTV
testSuite.ambiguityNote: LTV is null and must be derived; the rules do not say whether purchasePrice or appraisedValue is the denominator. With appraisedValue (81.36%) no rule applies; with purchasePrice (80%) ARM7/1 would apply.

testSuite.name: TC19_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM7/1 even with strong credit and low LTV

testSuite.name: TC20_HorizonZeroARM
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 years is within the allowed range; ARM7/1 applies

testSuite.name: TC21_CashOutManualLowCredit
testSuite.description: Refinance cash-out with credit score 580 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC22_AllNullApplication
testSuite.description: All decision inputs missing; no rule can be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All inputs are null; the rules do not state the outcome when values are missing. Most likely no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC23_FixedPreferenceNullCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true but credit score missing; Rule 3 cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null, so the manual review condition (creditScore < 640) cannot be evaluated. Fixed30 from Rule 1 is most likely; ManualReview is possible if missing values are treated as failing.

testSuite.name: TC24_ARMRequiresStableNotNull
testSuite.description: Income stability null blocks ARM7/1 and no other rule applies
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is null; the rules require stable income for ARM7/1 but do not state the outcome for missing values. Most likely no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC25_LowSensitivityNoRuleApplies
testSuite.description: Low sensitivity, no fixed preference, long horizon, moderate profile: no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference alone triggers Fixed30; no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 even though income is variable and credit score is moderate.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_TypicalCase
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV below 80 and credit score above 720 yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_InclusiveBoundaries
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80 and credit score exactly 720 satisfy the ARM7/1 conditions.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARM_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds seven years, so ARM7/1 does not apply and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC06_ARM_VariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM7/1 even when all other ARM conditions are met.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReview_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so the application goes to ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditExactly640_NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIExactly50_NoRule
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so ManualReview does not apply.

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReview_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50, so the application goes to ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVExactly95_NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so ManualReview does not apply.

testSuite.name: TC12_ManualReview_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 is above 95, so the application goes to ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC13_OverlapFixedAndARM
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is true and ARM7/1 conditions are also met, so both Fixed30 and ARM7/1 match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC14_OverlapFixedAndManualReview
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is true but credit score is below 640, so Fixed30 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ManualReview (creditScore<640) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC15_OverlapARMAndManualReviewDTI
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 conditions are met but DTI is above 50, so ARM7/1 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) and rule ManualReview (DTI>50) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC16_NullCreditScoreMissingValue
testSuite.description: Credit score is missing, so ARM7/1 cannot be confirmed and ManualReview cannot be confirmed either.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Possible outputs: no product (empty expected) or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC17_NullFixedPreferenceNoRateSensitivityMatch
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is null and rate sensitivity is medium, so Fixed30 does not apply; no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedPreferenceWithNullIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is true and income stability is missing; Fixed30 still applies because it does not depend on income stability.

testSuite.name: TC19_CashOutHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with high rate sensitivity yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC20_ARM_LTVJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 exceeds 80, so ARM7/1 does not apply and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до зміни ставки, без перевагі фіксованої ставки, призначається Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMTypicalBoundaries
testSuite.description: Всі умови ARM виконані на граничних значеннях: horizon 7, LTV 80, кредитний бал 720

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMTypicalMidRange
testSuite.description: Типовий ARM-випадок: короткий горизонт, стабільний дохід, помірний LTV та високий кредитний бал

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 років перевищує ліміт 7 років, ARM не призначається, правил що застосовуються немає

testSuite.name: TC06_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 перевищує ліміт 80 для ARM, правил що застосовуються немає

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelowARMLimit
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижче порогу 720 для ARM, але не нижче 640 для ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC08_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Нестабільний дохід, тому ARM не призначається; жодне правило не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreBoundary640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал рівно 640 не є нижчим за 640, ручний розгляд не призначається

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижче 640, заявка направляється на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIBoundary50
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50, ручний розгляд не призначається

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 перевищує 50, заявка направляється на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVBoundary95
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95, ручний розгляд не призначається

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 перевищує 95, заявка направляється на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Одночасно виконуються перевага фіксованої ставки (Fixed30) та низький кредитний бал (ManualReview)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (fixedPreference=true → Fixed30) та R3 (creditScore<640 → ManualReview) обидва виконуються; у правилах не сказано, який має пріоритет. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC16_HighSensitivityAndDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки та DTI понад 50 одночасно
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (rateSensitivity=high → Fixed30) та R3 (DTI>50 → ManualReview) обидва виконуються; пріоритет не визначено. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMConditionsAndDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: Умови ARM виконані, але DTI понад 50 та вимога ручного розгляду
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R2 (ARM7/1) та R3 (DTI>50 → ManualReview) обидва виконуються; пріоритет не визначено. Можливі результати: ARM7/1 або ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedPreferenceAndARMConditions
testSuite.description: Виконуються умови і Fixed30 (перевага фіксованої ставки), і ARM7/1
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (fixedPreference=true → Fixed30) та R2 (ARM7/1) обидва виконуються; пріоритет не визначено. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC19_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал відсутній (null), решта умов ARM виконані
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore=null: умова ARM (>=720) та умова ручного розгляду (<640) не можуть бути оцінені; можливі результати: [] або ManualReview. Обрано [].

testSuite.name: TC20_RefinanceCashOutARM
testSuite.description: Refinance_cash_out з виконаними умовами ARM, тип мети кредиту не впливає на рішення

testSuite.description: Horizon equal to 7 years still qualifies for ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonAboveSeven_NoRule
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds ARM limit and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_LTVAboveEighty_NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 fails ARM condition; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_VariableIncome_NoRule
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreBelow640_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreBoundary640_NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; ARM fails due to score below 720

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIBoundary50_NoRule
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIAbove50_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_LTVAbove95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVBoundary95_NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Fixed preference matches Fixed30 while credit score below 640 matches ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference) and rule 3 (ManualReview via creditScore<640) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedHighSensitivityAndARM
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 is chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC16_ARMAndDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI>50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview is chosen as the more likely safeguard.

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityAndLTVAbove95
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and LTV above 95
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via high rateSensitivity) and rule 3 (ManualReview via LTV>95) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; ARM and ManualReview conditions cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null: rule 2 (creditScore>=720) and rule 3 (creditScore<640) cannot be evaluated. Possible outputs: [] (no product) or ManualReview. Empty result is chosen.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullFixedPreferenceAndSensitivity
testSuite.description: Null fixedPreference and rateSensitivity do not trigger Fixed30; ARM applies

testSuite.name: TC20_NullIncomeStability_NoRule
testSuite.description: Null income stability fails ARM condition; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_only

testSuite.name: arm_typical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, good LTV and credit score

testSuite.name: arm_all_boundaries_inclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720

testSuite.name: arm_horizon_just_above_7
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the 7-year limit, no product matches

testSuite.name: arm_ltv_just_above_80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds the ARM limit and is not above 95, no product matches

testSuite.name: arm_credit_score_719
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below the ARM minimum of 720 and above the manual review threshold

testSuite.name: arm_variable_income
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM 7/1 and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: manual_review_credit_639
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: credit_640_boundary_no_review
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no product matches

testSuite.name: manual_review_dti_above_50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 is above 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: dti_exactly_50_no_review
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, no product matches

testSuite.name: manual_review_ltv_above_95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: ltv_exactly_95_no_review
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, no product matches

testSuite.name: overlap_fixed_and_arm
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM criteria both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules for Fixed30 and ARM7/1 both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: overlap_fixed_and_manual_review_credit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with high rate sensitivity and credit score below 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 and ManualReview both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: overlap_arm_and_manual_review_dti
testSuite.description: ARM criteria met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ARM7/1 and ManualReview both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview is expected as the safer outcome.

testSuite.name: overlap_fixed_and_manual_review_ltv

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 and ManualReview both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: missing_credit_ltv_dti
testSuite.description: Missing credit score, LTV and DTI; neither ARM nor manual review can be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Several inputs are null (creditScore, ltv, dti), so the ARM7/1 and ManualReview conditions cannot be evaluated. The rules do not say how missing values are handled; no product is expected.

testSuite.name: missing_ltv_dti_low_credit
testSuite.description: Credit score 500 with null LTV and DTI triggers manual review by credit alone
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Manual review is met by the credit score condition, but ltv and dti are null and the rules do not say how missing values are handled. ManualReview is expected.

testSuite.name: arm_horizon_zero_max_boundary
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 and LTV 0 with maximum credit score

testSuite.name: fixed_high_sensitivity_long_horizon
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with long horizon and stable income: only Fixed30 criteria met

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceOnly

testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference yields Fixed30

testSuite.name: FixedAndArmConditionsOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and all ARM conditions met, so Fixed30 and ARM7/1 both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 1 (Fixed30) and 2 (ARM7/1) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: ArmBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM boundary values inclusive (horizon 7, LTV 80, score 720) yield ARM7/1

testSuite.name: HorizonJustAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the 7-year limit, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM7/1 assignment

testSuite.name: LtvJustAboveArmLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: CreditScoreBelowArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Score 719 is below ARM threshold of 720 and above manual-review threshold

testSuite.name: CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Score 639 below 640 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Score 640 is not below 640, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI 50 is not over 50, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 is over 50 and ARM conditions are met, so the rules overlap
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 2 (ARM7/1) and 3 (ManualReview) both apply; precedence is not stated. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: LtvExactly95NoReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95 is not over 95, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is over 95 and sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceWithLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and score 600 both match, so Fixed30 and ManualReview overlap
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 1 (Fixed30) and 3 (ManualReview) both apply; precedence is not stated. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: HighSensitivityWithLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and LTV 98 both match, so Fixed30 and ManualReview overlap
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 1 (Fixed30) and 3 (ManualReview) both apply; precedence is not stated. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Null credit score makes ARM and manual-review conditions undeterminable
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: AllValuesNull
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All inputs are null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: NullIncomeStabilityNoArm
testSuite.description: Null income stability does not satisfy the stable-income condition
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Most likely no product since the stable-income condition is not met.

testSuite.name: MediumSensitivityNoFixed

testSuite.name: ArmWithCashOutPurpose
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance purpose does not affect ARM7/1 assignment when other conditions are met

testSuite.name: ArmWithDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 60 with all ARM conditions met overlaps with manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 2 (ARM7/1) and 3 (ManualReview) both apply; precedence is not stated. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: ZeroHorizonMaxScoreArm

testSuite.name: FixedAndLowScoreAndLtvAbove95

  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">

      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv = null then application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice = null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else if application.collateral.appraisedValue = null then application.collateral.purchasePrice else min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue)) * 100 else application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti = null then ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else application.dti</text>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_overlaps_arm

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 and ARM7/1 both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is chosen as the rule written first, which is the most likely outcome; ARM7/1 is also possible.

testSuite.name: null_credit_score_with_fixed_preference

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceExplicit
testSuite.description: Заявник явно вказав перевагу фіксованої ставки; R1 виконується, R2 і R3 ні.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до зміни ставки без явної переваги фіксованої; R1 виконується.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_Typical
testSuite.description: Короткий горизонт, стабільний дохід, LTV 75, кредитний бал 750; виконується R2.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_BoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Граничні значення R2: горизонт 7 років, LTV 80, кредитний бал 720; усі умови включно.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARM_HorizonTooLong
testSuite.description: Горизонт 8 років перевищує 7; R2 не виконується, інші правила не застосовуються.

testSuite.name: TC06_ARM_IncomeVariable
testSuite.description: Дохід нестабільний; R2 не виконується, жодне правило не застосовується.

testSuite.name: TC07_ARM_LtvJustAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.01 перевищує 80; R2 не виконується, R3 не виконується (LTV не понад 95).

testSuite.name: TC08_ARM_CreditBelow720
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижче 720; R2 не виконується, R3 не виконується (не нижче 640).

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualReview_LowCredit
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 600 нижче 640; виконується R3.

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReview_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 перевищує 50; виконується R3, R2 не виконується через кредитний бал 700.

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50; жодне правило не застосовується.

testSuite.name: TC12_ManualReview_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 перевищує 95; виконується R3, R2 не виконується через LTV більше 80.

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95; жодне правило не застосовується.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndManualOverlap
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки і низький кредитний бал 600 одночасно; виконуються R1 і R3.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Виконуються R1 (fixedPreference=true → Fixed30) і R3 (creditScore<640 → ManualReview). Правила не визначають, яке має пріоритет; можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmAndManualOverlapDti
testSuite.description: R2 виконується (горизонт 5, стабільний дохід, LTV 70, кредитний бал 750), але DTI 55 > 50 активує R3.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Виконуються R2 (ARM7/1) і R3 (dti>50 → ManualReview). Правила не визначають пріоритет; можливі ARM7/1 або ManualReview. Обрано ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedAndArmOverlap
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки і умови R2 одночасно.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Виконуються R1 (fixedPreference=true → Fixed30) і R2 (ARM7/1). Правила не визначають пріоритет; можливі Fixed30 або ARM7/1. Обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал відсутній (null); умови R2 і R3 не можна перевірити.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore=null: R2 не можна підтвердити (потрібно >=720), R3 не можна підтвердити (потрібно <640). Не визначено, що відбувається при відсутньому значенні; обрано [].

testSuite.name: TC18_MissingIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Стабільність доходу відсутня; R2 не можна підтвердити.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability=null, fixedPreference=null, rateSensitivity=null: R1 і R2 не можна підтвердити. Правила не описують поведінку за відсутніх значень; обрано [].

testSuite.name: TC19_CashOutHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Рефінансування з готівкою та висока чутливість до ставки; виконується R1.

testSuite.name: TC20_MediumSensitivityNoPreference
testSuite.description: Середня чутливість і fixedPreference=false; R1 не виконується, кредитний бал 700 не активує R3.

testSuite.name: TC21_ComputedLtvArm
testSuite.description: LTV не передано (null), DMN має обчислити 80% із суми кредиту та оцінки; умови R2 виконуються при LTV 80.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv=null: значення має обчислити DMN (240000/300000=80%); правила не уточнюють, яку оцінку використовувати (purchasePrice чи appraisedValue). Обрано ARM7/1.

flaggedCases.note: Виконуються R1 (fixedPreference=true → Fixed30) і R3 (creditScore<640 → ManualReview). Правила не визначають, яке має пріоритет; можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано Fixed30.
Виконуються R2 (ARM7/1) і R3 (dti>50 → ManualReview). Правила не визначають пріоритет; можливі ARM7/1 або ManualReview. Обрано ARM7/1.
Виконуються R1 (fixedPreference=true → Fixed30) і R2 (ARM7/1). Правила не визначають пріоритет; можливі Fixed30 або ARM7/1. Обрано Fixed30.
creditScore=null: R2 не можна підтвердити (потрібно >=720), R3 не можна підтвердити (потрібно <640). Не визначено, що відбувається при відсутньому значенні; обрано [].
incomeStability=null, fixedPreference=null, rateSensitivity=null: R1 і R2 не можна підтвердити. Правила не описують поведінку за відсутніх значень; обрано [].
ltv=null: значення має обчислити DMN (240000/300000=80%); правила не уточнюють, яку оцінку використовувати (purchasePrice чи appraisedValue). Обрано ARM7/1.

testSuite.description: fixedPreference true; horizon >7, so R2 fails; no R3 condition. Expect Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: rateSensitivity high, other conditions fail R2 and R3. Expect Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_BoundaryLtv80CreditScore720
testSuite.description: Boundary: horizon 5, stable income, LTV exactly 80, credit exactly 720. Expect ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_BoundaryHorizon7
testSuite.description: Boundary: horizon exactly 7 years with all other R2 conditions met. Expect ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_NoRule_HorizonAbove7
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years fails R2; no other rule applies. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC06_NoRule_LtvJustAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails R2 (LTV <=80); LTV not above 95 so R3 fails. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC07_NoRule_CreditScoreJustBelow720
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails R2 (>=720); above 640 so R3 fails. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC08_NoRule_VariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails R2; no other rule applies. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualReview_LowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score 600 is below 640; R2 fails on credit score. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReview_CreditScoreBoundary639
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is just below 640. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC11_NoRule_CreditScoreBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no other rule applies. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC12_ManualReview_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC13_NoRule_DtiBoundary50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no other rule applies. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC14_ManualReview_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC15_NoRule_LtvBoundary95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no other rule applies. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC16_Conflict_FixedPreferenceAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: fixedPreference true (R1) and credit 600 (R3) both match. Rules do not state precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R3 (creditScore<640 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as most likely by rule order.

testSuite.name: TC17_Conflict_HighSensitivityAndHighDti
testSuite.description: rateSensitivity high (R1) and DTI 55 (R3) both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and R3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as most likely by rule order.

testSuite.name: TC18_Conflict_FixedPreferenceAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: fixedPreference true (R1) and all R2 conditions met (horizon 5, stable, LTV 70, credit 750).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 chosen as most likely by rule order.

testSuite.name: TC19_Conflict_ArmConditionsAndHighDti
testSuite.description: All R2 conditions met but DTI 55 triggers R3.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) and R3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview; ManualReview chosen as most likely since the rule states the application must go to manual review without automatic assignment.

testSuite.name: TC20_Missing_LtvNullNoCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV is null and no collateral data to derive it; R2 cannot be confirmed.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: LTV is missing (null) and collateral is absent, so the R2 LTV<=80 condition cannot be evaluated; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Most likely no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC21_AllNullAttributes
testSuite.description: Only id provided; no rule conditions can be satisfied.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference alone triggers Fixed30; no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference triggers Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, low LTV and good credit score qualify for ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720 all satisfy ARM7/1 conditions inclusively.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMCreditBelowThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 so ARM7/1 does not apply and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC06_ManualReviewLowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review is required.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReviewHighDTI
testSuite.description: DTI of 51 exceeds 50, so manual review is required.

testSuite.name: TC08_ManualReviewHighLTV
testSuite.description: LTV of 96 exceeds 95, so manual review is required; ARM7/1 fails due to LTV above 80.

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIBoundaryNotExceeded
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so manual review does not apply and no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC10_LTVBoundaryNotExceeded
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so manual review does not apply and no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditBoundaryNotLow
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so manual review does not apply and no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedVsARMConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM7/1 conditions are both met.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference) and rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 expected.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedVsManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies while credit score below 640 triggers manual review.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and rule 3 (ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 expected.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARMVsManualDTIConflict
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 conditions are met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI above 50) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ARM7/1 expected.

testSuite.name: TC15_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Missing credit score makes ARM7/1 condition unmet and manual-review condition cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is missing (null); the rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Possible outputs: no product (expected []) or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC16_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the ARM7/1 stability requirement and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC17_HorizonAboveSevenNoARM
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so ARM7/1 does not apply.

testSuite.name: TC18_MediumSensitivityNoMatch
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and no fixed preference do not trigger Fixed30; other conditions unmet.

testSuite.name: TC19_LTVDerivedFromAppraisal
testSuite.description: LTV is null and must be derived; appraised value 295000 with loan 240000 gives about 81.4%, above 80, so ARM7/1 does not apply.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null and the rules do not state how LTV is derived (purchase price vs appraised value). Using appraised value gives 81.4% (no match, expected []); using purchase price gives 80% (ARM7/1 would match).
