testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ARM7/1 (all conditions met) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Expected Fixed30 assuming written order.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true with credit score 600; Fixed30 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ManualReview (creditScore below 640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Expected Fixed30 assuming written order.

testSuite.name: TC17_ArmConditionsAndHighDtiConflict
testSuite.description: All ARM conditions met but DTI 55 triggers manual review; both ARM7/1 and ManualReview match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule ARM7/1 (all conditions met) and rule ManualReview (DTI above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. Expected ARM7/1 assuming written order.

testSuite.name: TC18_HighSensitivityAndHighLtvConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with LTV 97; Fixed30 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and rule ManualReview (LTV above 95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Expected Fixed30 assuming written order.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullLtvAndDtiNotComputed
testSuite.description: LTV and DTI are null and no collateral or income data is provided; ARM conditions cannot be verified.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null and DMN must compute it, but no collateral data is given; rules do not say how missing LTV or DTI is handled. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC20_NullIncomeStability
testSuite.description: incomeStability is null so the stable-income condition cannot be confirmed.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is null; rules do not state how missing values are treated. Possible outputs: [] or other interpretation.

testSuite.name: TC21_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: creditScore is null; neither ARM nor manual threshold can be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are treated. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC22_AllOptionalFieldsNull
testSuite.description: Only application id present; all decision inputs are null.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are missing; rules do not define behavior for missing values. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC23_ZeroCreditScoreManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 is below 640; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC24_MaxCreditScoreArmZeroHorizon
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score and zero horizon with stable income and zero LTV; expects ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC25_FixedPreferenceFalseHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: fixedPreference false but rate sensitivity high; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC26_LowSensitivityFixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Low rate sensitivity but explicit fixed preference; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC27_MediumSensitivityNoFixedNoMatch
testSuite.description: Medium sensitivity, no fixed preference, credit 650, not all ARM conditions met; no rule applies.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with long horizon and variable income; only R1 matches, so Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (R1) and all R2 conditions met; rules overlap.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true or rateSensitivity high) and R2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order R1 first.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmAllBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: All R2 boundary values inclusive (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720); only R2 matches, so ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmHorizonJustOverLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds 7; R2 fails and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmCreditJustBelowLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720; R2 fails and no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; only R3 matches.

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditExactly640NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC08_DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50; only R3 matches.

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiExactly50NoRule
testSuite.description: DTI 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95; R2 fails due to LTV and R3 matches.

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvExactly95NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV 95 is not above 95 and exceeds 80, so R2 fails; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedPreferenceWithLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (R1) and LTV above 95 (R3) both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true) and R3 (LTV>95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order R1 first.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceWithLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (R1) and credit below 640 (R3) both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true) and R3 (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order R1 first.

testSuite.name: TC14_LowCreditArmProfileManualReview
testSuite.description: Low credit blocks R2 and R3 matches; only ManualReview applies.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmProfileWithDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: R2 conditions met (DTI not part of R2) but DTI 55 triggers R3.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM conditions met; DTI not considered) and R3 (DTI>50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected ARM7/1 assuming table order R2 before R3.

testSuite.name: TC16_ArmProfileWithLtvAbove95Conflict
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 fails R2 so only R3 applies; control case with fixed preference false.

testSuite.name: TC17_NullKeyFieldsMissingValues
testSuite.description: Credit score, LTV and DTI are null; conditions cannot be evaluated and no rule is clearly satisfied.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore, ltv, dti are null, so R2 and R3 conditions cannot be determined; rules do not say how missing values are handled. Expected no output assumed.

testSuite.name: TC18_HighSensitivityVariableIncome
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with variable income; only R1 matches.

testSuite.name: TC19_ArmMaxCreditScoreZeroLtv
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score 900 and LTV 0 with short horizon; only R2 matches.

testSuite.name: TC20_RateSensitivityLowNoRule
testSuite.description: Low rate sensitivity, variable income and no fixed preference; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC21_ArmCreditExactly720WithFixedFalseMediumSensitivity
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity does not trigger R1; R2 matches at boundary values.

testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference triggers Fixed30

testSuite.name: ARM7_1BoundaryValues
testSuite.description: All ARM 7/1 criteria at inclusive boundaries (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720)

testSuite.name: ARMRefinanceCashOut
testSuite.description: ARM 7/1 criteria met for a cash-out refinance application

testSuite.name: HorizonJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds ARM limit; no rule applies

testSuite.name: VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM 7/1 and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 exceeds ARM limit; no rule applies

testSuite.name: CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 so the application goes to manual review

testSuite.name: CreditScore640AndDTI50NoRule
testSuite.description: Boundary: credit score 640 is not below 640 and DTI 50 is not above 50, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: DTIAbove50WithARMConditions
testSuite.description: DTI 51 triggers manual review while ARM conditions are also met; precedence not stated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ARM7/1 rule (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) and ManualReview rule (DTI>50) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95 so the application goes to manual review

testSuite.name: LTVExactly95NoRule
testSuite.description: Boundary: LTV 95 is not above 95 and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceWithLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Fixed preference matches Fixed30 while low credit score matches ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview rule (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first listed rule.

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceWithARMConditions
testSuite.description: Fixed preference matches Fixed30 while ARM conditions are also met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule and ARM7/1 rule both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as the first listed rule.

testSuite.name: HighSensitivityWithARMConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity matches Fixed30 while ARM conditions are also met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (rateSensitivity high) and ARM7/1 rule both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as the first listed rule.

testSuite.name: HighRiskFixedPreferenceAndLowCreditAndHighLTV
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with high rate sensitivity, credit 500 and LTV 97 matches both Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview rule (creditScore<640 or LTV>95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first listed rule.

testSuite.name: AllValuesMissing
testSuite.description: All decision inputs are null so no rule can be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Missing values for all decision inputs; rules do not state how null values are handled. Most likely no rule matches, so expected is an empty result.

testSuite.name: CreditScoreAtARMThresholdWithFixedNo
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 720 with stable income and short horizon, fixed preference false; ARM 7/1 applies

testSuite.name: CreditScore719NoARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below the ARM threshold of 720; no rule applies

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then application.collateral.appraisedValue else application.collateral.purchasePrice) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.dti = null) then application.dti else (sum(if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest, if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes, if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance, if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa, if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">

        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>

      </input>

      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">

          <text></text>

          <text></text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">

          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

          <text></text>

          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule matching; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV below 80, credit score at least 720; expects ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: All ARM boundaries reached exactly (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, DTI 50 not over limit); expects ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonAboveSevenNoRuleMatches
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds ARM limit, no other rule applies; expects no product.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC07_DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 with no other rule matching; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC08_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC09_LtvExactly95NotManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies, expects no product.

testSuite.name: TC10_FixedPreferenceAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference triggers Fixed30 while low credit triggers ManualReview.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC11_FixedPreferenceAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and all ARM conditions are met simultaneously.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC12_ArmConditionsAndDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met but DTI 51 also triggers ManualReview.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (ManualReview) both match via DTI above 50; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview; ARM7/1 chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC13_HighSensitivityAndLowCreditAndHighLtv
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity together with low credit score and LTV above 95.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC14_NullCreditScoreMissingValue
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; ARM and ManualReview conditions cannot be confirmed.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how a missing creditScore is handled. Possible outputs: no product (expected []) or ManualReview; no product chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC15_NullLtvAndDtiMissingValues
testSuite.description: LTV and DTI are null, so their conditions cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how missing ltv or dti (which DMN would derive) are handled. Possible outputs: no product or ARM7/1 if derived values meet conditions; no product chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC16_EmptyApplicationNoData
testSuite.description: Only id is provided; no rule conditions can be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state behavior when all attributes are missing. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview; no product chosen as most likely.

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (Fixed30) та R2 (ARM7/1) одночасно виконуються; у rules не сказано, яке має пріоритет. Очікується Fixed30 як перше правило.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndManualReviewOverlap
testSuite.description: rateSensitivity high при creditScore 600 (нижче 640): застосовні Fixed30 і ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (Fixed30) та R3 (ManualReview) одночасно виконуються; пріоритет не вказано. Очікується Fixed30 як перше правило.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryValuesIncluded
testSuite.description: Граничні значення для ARM7/1: horizon 7, LTV 80, creditScore 720, стабільний дохід

testSuite.name: TC04_HorizonAboveSevenNoRule
testSuite.description: horizonYears 8 перевищує 7, інші правила не виконуються

testSuite.name: TC05_VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Нестабільний дохід блокує ARM7/1, інші правила не виконуються

testSuite.name: TC06_LtvAboveEightyNoArm
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 перевищує 80, ARM7/1 не призначається, ManualReview не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelowArmThresholdNoRule
testSuite.description: creditScore 719 нижче 720 для ARM7/1, але не нижче 640 для ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: creditScore рівно 640 не є нижче 640, ручний розгляд не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: creditScore 639 нижче 640 призводить до ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactly50NoManual
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50, ручний розгляд не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiAboveFiftyManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 перевищує 50, заявка на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95, ручний розгляд не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 перевищує 95, заявка на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC14_HighSensitivityAndLtvAbove95Overlap
testSuite.description: rateSensitivity high і LTV 97: застосовні Fixed30 і ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (Fixed30) та R3 (ManualReview) одночасно виконуються; пріоритет не вказано. Очікується Fixed30 як перше правило.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceOnlyFixed30
testSuite.description: fixedPreference true без виконання інших умов, призначається Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC16_HighSensitivityOnlyFixed30
testSuite.description: rateSensitivity high без виконання умов ARM7/1, призначається Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC17_NullCreditScoreAmbiguous
testSuite.description: creditScore відсутній, умови ARM7/1 та ManualReview не можна перевірити
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore = null: умови R2 (creditScore >= 720) та R3 (creditScore < 640) невизначені; rules не визначають обробку відсутніх значень. Очікується відсутність продукту.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullFixedPreferenceWithRateSensitivityHigh
testSuite.description: fixedPreference відсутній, rateSensitivity high, інші поля відсутні
testSuite.ambiguityNote: fixedPreference = null, ltv/dti/creditScore відсутні; R3 не можна перевірити. Відсутні значення не описані в rules. Очікується Fixed30 за R1.

testSuite.name: TC19_EmptyApplicationAmbiguous
testSuite.description: Заявка лише з ідентифікатором, усі атрибути відсутні
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Усі атрибути для рішення відсутні (null); rules не описують обробку відсутніх даних. Очікується відсутність продукту.

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">

          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">

      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if not(application.ltv = null) then application.ltv else (if application.purpose = "purchase" and not(application.collateral.purchasePrice = null) and not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else if not(application.collateral.appraisedValue = null) then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.purchasePrice * 100)</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">

        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">

        </inputEntry>

testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails R2 but is not below 640, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualReview_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, only R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReview_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 is above 50, only R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualReview_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 is above 95, only R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC12_Boundary_DTIExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC13_Boundary_LTVExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_Boundary_CreditExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC15_Conflict_R1_R3
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (R1) and credit below 640 (R3) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixed preference, Fixed30) and R3 (credit below 640, ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as first listed.

testSuite.name: TC16_Conflict_R1_R2
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (R1) and all ARM conditions (R2) both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 chosen as first listed.

testSuite.name: TC17_Conflict_R2_R3
testSuite.description: ARM conditions (R2) met but DTI above 50 triggers R3
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1) and R3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview; ARM7/1 chosen as first listed.

testSuite.name: TC18_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null, so R2 credit condition and R3 credit condition cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not say how missing values are treated. Possible outputs: no product (empty) or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullPurposeAndIncomeStability_FixedPref
testSuite.description: Null purpose and null income stability do not affect R1, which applies alone

testSuite.name: TC20_NullLTV_FixedPref
testSuite.description: LTV is null, so R3 LTV condition is unknown; R1 applies
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; rules do not say how a missing LTV is evaluated against R3 (LTV above 95). Fixed30 is likely since R1 is met and R3 other conditions are false.

testSuite.name: TC21_ManualReview_AllR3Conditions
testSuite.description: Credit below 640, DTI above 50 and LTV above 95 all at once, only R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC22_Conflict_R1_R2_HighSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (R1) and all ARM conditions (R2) both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 chosen as first listed.

testSuite.name: TC09_VariableIncomeNoARM

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not below 640; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_DTIExactly50NoManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC15_LTVExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceAndManualConditions

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is given as most likely.

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R2 (ARM7/1) and R3 (ManualReview, DTI above 50) both match; no stated precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview is given as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullHorizonWithHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Horizon is missing; fixed preference via high rate sensitivity applies
testSuite.ambiguityNote: horizonYears is null; ARM rule cannot be evaluated, but Fixed30 rule R1 matches. Expected Fixed30 as the only applicable rule; missing value handling is not stated in rules.

testSuite.name: TC20_NullHorizonNoMatch
testSuite.description: Horizon is missing so the ARM rule cannot be satisfied; no other rule matches
testSuite.ambiguityNote: horizonYears is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is treated. Expected empty result as most likely, since the ARM condition cannot be confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC21_NullCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; fixed preference matches R1, manual review condition cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how missing values affect the manual-review condition. Fixed30 is expected as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC22_CashOutRefinanceARM
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with ARM criteria met; purpose is not used in rules

testSuite.name: TC23_MediumSensitivityNoMatch
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity without fixed preference and with variable income; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC24_FixedPreferenceFalseExplicit

testSuite.name: TC25_CreditAtMaxBoundaryARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 900 with ARM criteria met

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (sum([application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip]) + (if application.debts != null then sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки, інші критерії ARM і ручного розгляду не виконуються

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки без явної переваги фіксованої ставки

testSuite.description: Усі умови ARM виконані на межах: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720

testSuite.description: Горизонт 8 років перевищує 7, ARM не призначається, решта критеріїв не спрацьовує

testSuite.name: TC05_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал рівно 640 не є нижчим за 640, ручний розгляд не призначається

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижче 640, заявка направляється на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC07_DTIExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50, ручний розгляд не призначається

testSuite.name: TC08_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 51 перевищує 50, заявка направляється на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC09_LTVExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95, ручний розгляд не призначається, ARM не підходить через LTV above 80

testSuite.name: TC10_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 перевищує 95, заявка направляється на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC11_FixedVsManualConflict
testSuite.description: Є явна перевага фіксованої ставки, але кредитний бал 600 нижче 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 і ManualReview одночасно виконуються (fixedPreference=true, creditScore<640). Правила не визначають явного пріоритету; ймовірний результат Fixed30 за порядком таблиці (Hit Policy FIRST), але можливий ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedVsARMConflict
testSuite.description: Перевага фіксованої ставки і всі умови ARM 7/1 виконуються одночасно
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 і ARM7/1 одночасно виконуються. Правила не визначають явного пріоритету; ймовірний результат Fixed30 за порядком таблиці (Hit Policy FIRST), але можливий ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC13_ARMVsManualDTIConflict
testSuite.description: Усі умови ARM виконуються, але DTI 55 перевищує 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила ARM7/1 і ManualReview одночасно виконуються (dti>50). Правила не визначають явного пріоритету; ймовірний результат ARM7/1 за порядком таблиці (Hit Policy FIRST), але можливий ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC14_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал не вказано (null), жодне правило явно не виконується
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила не визначають поведінку при відсутньому creditScore. Ймовірний результат [] (ні ARM, ні ManualReview не виконуються), але можлива обробка як некоректних даних із ручним розглядом.

testSuite.name: TC15_VariableIncomeBlocksARM
testSuite.description: Нестабільний дохід блокує ARM, інші умови для Fixed30 та ManualReview не виконуються

testSuite.name: TC16_MediumRateSensitivityNullFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Чутливість середня, fixedPreference не вказано, горизонт великий - жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMLTVJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 перевищує 80, ARM не призначається

testSuite.name: TC18_ARMCreditJustBelowLimit
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижче 720, ARM не призначається, ручний розгляд не потрібен

testSuite.name: TC19_ZeroHorizonARM
testSuite.description: Горизонт 0 років (мінімальне значення) з усіма іншими умовами ARM

testSuite.name: TC20_ManualReviewCreditAndDTI

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>=720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">

      </rule>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">

        </inputEntry>

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule conditions met; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighSensitivityAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (Fixed30) and all ARM7/1 conditions met simultaneously.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true or rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and R2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, score>=720 -> ARM7/1) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Chosen output follows rule order (R1).

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM7/1 boundary values hit exactly (horizon 7, LTV 80, score 720); boundaries are inclusive per 'або менше' and 'щонайменше'.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmFailsVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Short horizon and good score but variable income; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC05_CreditScoreBelowMinimum
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreAtBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review and does not meet ARM score; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC07_DtiAtBoundary50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not over 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC08_DtiAboveLimit
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: TC09_LtvAtBoundary95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not over 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_LtvAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, triggering manual review; ARM not met due to LTV above 80.

testSuite.name: TC11_FixedPreferenceWithLowScore
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true with credit score 600 triggers both Fixed30 and ManualReview.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R3 (creditScore<640 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Chosen output follows rule order (R1).

testSuite.name: TC12_ArmConditionsWithDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI 55 exceeds 50, triggering manual review.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) and R3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Chosen output follows rule order (R2).

testSuite.name: TC13_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null; ARM cannot be confirmed and ManualReview cannot be confirmed.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Most likely no rule applies, yielding no product.

testSuite.name: TC14_NullPreferenceNoRule
testSuite.description: Fixed preference null and medium sensitivity; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceUnstableIncome
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true with variable income; only Fixed30 applies.

testSuite.name: TC16_ArmWithCashOutRefinance
testSuite.description: Refinance cash-out purpose with all ARM7/1 conditions met; purpose does not affect the rule.

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityHighScore
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with long horizon and high score; only Fixed30 applies.

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>

        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv = null then (application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice = null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else if application.collateral.appraisedValue = null then application.collateral.purchasePrice else min([application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue])) * 100) else application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti = null then ((if application.housing.principalInterest = null then 0 else application.housing.principalInterest) + (if application.housing.taxes = null then 0 else application.housing.taxes) + (if application.housing.insurance = null then 0 else application.housing.insurance) + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMAllBoundariesMet
testSuite.description: Horizon 5 years, stable income, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720. Expected ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMHorizonBoundarySevenYears
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years (inclusive). Expected ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonAboveSevenNoMatch
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years fails ARM condition; no other rule applies. Expected no product.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review. Expected ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreExactly640NoMatch
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies. Expected no product.

testSuite.name: TC08_DTIAboveFiftyWithARMConditions
testSuite.description: DTI 51 triggers manual review while ARM conditions are otherwise met. Rules R2 and R3 both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) and ManualReview (DTI>50) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview expected.

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIExactlyFiftyNotManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so ARM applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_LTVAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 96 is above 95, triggering manual review. Expected ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVExactlyNinetyFiveNoMatch
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95 and fails ARM LTV limit; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedPreferenceWithLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true but credit score 600 triggers manual review.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview (credit score below 640) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. ManualReview expected.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceAndARMConditions

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ARM7/1 (all ARM conditions met) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 expected.

testSuite.name: TC14_HighSensitivityWithLowCreditAndHighDTI

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview (credit below 640 and DTI above 50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. ManualReview expected.

testSuite.name: TC16_LTVAboveEightyBlocksARM

testSuite.name: TC17_CreditBelowARMThreshold

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv = null then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100 else application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti = null then (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + application.housing.hoa + application.housing.mip + sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false then 0 else d.monthlyPayment)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else application.dti</text>

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else ((if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0) + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity while all ARM conditions are also met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixed30 via high rate sensitivity) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions all met) both match; rules do not state precedence, so Fixed30 is chosen by rule order under FIRST policy

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmAllConditionsMet
testSuite.description: ARM 7/1 when all conditions are met with no fixed preference and no manual triggers

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Boundary values for ARM: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720 are all inclusive

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveArmLimit

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM assignment and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreExactly640NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiAbove50ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI of exactly 50 is not over 50, so no manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV of 96 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV of exactly 95 does not exceed 95; ARM fails due to LTV above 80, so no product

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceWithLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and credit score 600 trigger both Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixed preference) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via credit score below 640) both match; rules do not state precedence, Fixed30 chosen by rule order under FIRST policy

testSuite.name: TC14_ArmConditionsWithHighDtiManualReview
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI of 55 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions all met) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence, ARM7/1 chosen by rule order under FIRST policy

testSuite.name: TC15_MediumSensitivityArmOnly
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity is not high, so only ARM applies

testSuite.name: TC16_MissingHorizonWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Horizon is null and fixed preference is true; ARM cannot be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Horizon is null; rules do not state how a missing value is treated for the ARM condition. Fixed30 is expected since ARM cannot be confirmed

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingCreditScoreNoProduct

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Credit score is null; rules do not state how a missing value is treated for ARM (>=720) or ManualReview (<640) conditions. Empty result is expected
