<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice = null then application.collateral.appraisedValue else min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue)) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + (if application.housing.hoa = null then 0 else application.housing.hoa) + (if application.housing.mip = null then 0 else application.housing.mip) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><= 7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><= 80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>= 720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text>< 640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>> 50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>> 95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 with no other rule applying

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_BoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, stable income, LTV 80, credit score 720 (all inclusive boundaries) gives ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_Typical
testSuite.description: Typical ARM7/1 applicant with short horizon and strong profile

testSuite.name: TC05_ARM_ZeroValues
testSuite.description: Zero horizon and LTV with maximum credit score gives ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonAboveSeven_NoRule
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds ARM limit and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditBelowARMThreshold_NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 so ARM fails and no manual review triggers

testSuite.name: TC08_LTVAboveARMThreshold_NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_VariableIncome_NoRule
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditBelow640_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditExactly640_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so no manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIAbove50_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_DTIExactly50_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVAbove95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 and triggers manual review, ARM fails on LTV

testSuite.name: TC15_LTVExactly95_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no manual review

testSuite.name: TC16_CreditZero_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC17_FixedPreferenceAndARM_Conflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM conditions both met; rules do not state precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R2 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Most likely Fixed30 (first listed).

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedPreferenceAndManualReview_Conflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with low credit score; both Fixed30 and ManualReview conditions met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true) and R3 (credit<640) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Most likely Fixed30 (first listed).

testSuite.name: TC19_ARMAndManualReview_DTIConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50 also triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) and R3 (DTI>50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. Most likely ManualReview as the safety check.

testSuite.name: TC20_HighSensitivityAndManualReview_Conflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity combined with credit below 640, LTV above 95 and DTI above 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (rateSensitivity high) and R3 (credit<640 or DTI>50 or LTV>95) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Most likely Fixed30 (first listed).

testSuite.name: TC21_NullCreditScore_Ambiguous
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; rules do not define how null values are treated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null, so both ARM (credit>=720) and ManualReview (credit<640) conditions cannot be evaluated; the rules do not say how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: no product (empty) or ManualReview. Most likely empty result.

testSuite.name: TC22_NullLTV_FixedPreference
testSuite.description: LTV missing but fixed preference explicitly true, so Fixed30 applies regardless of LTV

testSuite.name: TC23_CashOutRefinance_FixedPreference
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance applicant with fixed-rate preference

testSuite.name: TC24_RateTermRefinance_ARM
testSuite.description: Rate-term refinance with short horizon and strong profile gives ARM7/1

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (sum([if application.housing.principalInterest != null then application.housing.principalInterest else 0, if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0, if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0, if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0, if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0]) + (if application.debts != null then sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include = false or d.monthlyPayment = null then 0 else d.monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">

        </inputEntry>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other conditions met; R1 applies

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference; R1 applies

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMAllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720 exactly; R2 boundaries are inclusive

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Typical short-horizon stable-income borrower with good credit and low LTV

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7; R2 fails and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeNoRule
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks R2; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not below 640 and below 720; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 51 is above 50; R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 is above 95; R3 applies

testSuite.name: TC12_LTVExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedAndManualOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (R1) and credit score below 640 (R3) both met; precedence not stated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true or high rate sensitivity -> Fixed30) and R3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARMAndManualOverlapByDTI
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, good credit (R2) but DTI above 50 (R3); precedence not stated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) and R3 (DTI > 50 -> ManualReview) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndARMOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (R1) and all ARM conditions (R2) met; precedence not stated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as the rule written first.

testSuite.name: TC16_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null; R2 cannot be confirmed and R3 cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null: R2 requires creditScore >= 720 and R3 requires creditScore < 640, neither can be confirmed. Possible outputs: no product (empty) or ManualReview if missing data is treated as manual review. Empty expected chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC17_LTVComputedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV is null and must be derived from loan amount and appraised value (80%); other R2 conditions met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; rules do not state whether DMN computes LTV from loan.amount/collateral and DTI is also null, so DTI-based R3 cannot be evaluated. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 if LTV computed as 80, or no product if LTV is treated as missing.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullRateFieldsNoFixedPreference
testSuite.description: fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are null, so R1 is not met; R2 conditions met

testSuite.name: TC19_ManualReviewCreditAndLTV
testSuite.description: Low credit score and high LTV both trigger R3 with a single outcome

testSuite.name: TC20_MinimumValidCreditScoreRefinance
testSuite.description: Refinance rate-term with credit score 900 and stable income and horizon 0; R2 applies

  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / (if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.purchasePrice < application.collateral.appraisedValue then application.collateral.purchasePrice else application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100</text>

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not over 50; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50 and sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not over 95; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95 and sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and low score below 640 both match; precedence not stated in rules
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) and ManualReview (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order (FIRST policy).

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndArmConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and all ARM conditions met; precedence not stated in rules
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) and ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, score>=720) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC16_ArmAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review; precedence not stated in rules
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules ARM7/1 and ManualReview (dti>50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected ARM7/1 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC17_FixedAndManualHighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with score 500 matches Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (rateSensitivity=high) and ManualReview (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullLtvComputedByDmn
testSuite.description: LTV is null and must be derived from loan and appraised value (80%); ARM conditions then met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; rules do not state how LTV is derived when missing. Expected ARM7/1 assuming LTV computed as 240000/300000 = 80%.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullCreditScoreFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Credit score missing but fixed preference explicitly true
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state whether missing score triggers ManualReview. Fixed30 matched by fixedPreference=true is expected.

testSuite.name: TC20_RefinanceArm
testSuite.description: Refinance cash-out purpose with short horizon, stable income and strong profile qualifies for ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC21_VariableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM even though other ARM conditions are met; no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC22_ZeroHorizonEdge
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 and extreme values still satisfy ARM conditions

testSuite.name: TC23_FixedAndManualDtiConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true with DTI above 50 matches both Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) and ManualReview (dti>50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC24_AllFieldsNullMissingData
testSuite.description: Application with no decision-relevant attributes provided
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are null; rules do not state the outcome for missing values. Expected [] as no rule can be confirmed.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Decision Table Configuration">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.collateral.purchasePrice != null then application.loan.amount / application.collateral.purchasePrice * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else (application.housing.principalInterest + application.housing.taxes + application.housing.insurance + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(application.debts[include != false].monthlyPayment) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>=720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text><640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>>95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference; rule 2 fails because horizon and income stability do not qualify. Expect Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityLongHorizon
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with long horizon; rule 2 fails on horizon. Expect Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryLowSensitivity
testSuite.description: All ARM conditions met at inclusive boundaries (horizon 5, LTV 80, score 720). Expect ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmHorizonBoundarySevenYears
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years with medium sensitivity; all ARM conditions met. Expect ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmZeroHorizonMaxScore
testSuite.description: Zero horizon, maximum credit score and zero LTV; all ARM conditions met. Expect ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonJustOverSevenNoMatch
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years fails rule 2; no fixed preference, no high sensitivity, no manual-review condition. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; rule 2 also fails on score. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreExactly640NoMatch
testSuite.description: Credit score 640, DTI 50 and LTV 95 are all at boundaries that do not trigger manual review; ARM not met. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review; no other rule applies. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC10_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review; ARM fails on LTV. Expect ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvAndDtiAtBoundaryNoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 and DTI exactly 50 do not trigger manual review; ARM not met. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC12_IncomeStabilityNotStableNoArm
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM rule; no other rule applies. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC13_CreditScoreBelowArmThresholdNoMatch
testSuite.description: Score 700 is above 640 but below 720; ARM fails and manual review not triggered. Expect no product.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceAndLowScoreOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true while credit score 600 triggers manual review. Both rule 1 and rule 3 match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and rule 3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is assumed from rule order.

testSuite.name: TC15_HighSensitivityAndArmCriteriaOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity while all ARM criteria are met. Both rule 1 and rule 2 match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and rule 2 (horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, score >= 720 -> ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 is assumed from rule order.

testSuite.name: TC16_HighSensitivityAndHighLtvOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with LTV 98 which triggers manual review. Both rule 1 and rule 3 match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and rule 3 (LTV > 95 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is assumed from rule order.

testSuite.name: TC17_NullCreditScoreAmbiguous
testSuite.description: Credit score is missing; ARM cannot be confirmed and manual review condition cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rule 2 requires score >= 720 and rule 3 requires score < 640, neither can be evaluated. Possible outputs: no product (empty) or ManualReview. Empty is assumed.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullIncomeStabilityNoArm
testSuite.description: Income stability is null, so the stable-income condition of rule 2 is not met; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC02_Fixed30_explicit_fixed_preference
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with variable income and long horizon: Fixed30 only.

testSuite.name: TC03_Fixed30_high_rate_sensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference, variable income, long horizon: Fixed30 only.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_inclusive_boundaries
testSuite.description: Boundary values horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720 are inclusive; fixedPreference null is not explicit: ARM 7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_no_rule_applies
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 exceeds 7 years, no fixed preference, low sensitivity, no matching rule: empty result.

testSuite.name: TC06_ManualReview_credit_below_640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 with otherwise acceptable values: ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC07_credit_exactly_640_no_rule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; it fails ARM criteria (needs 720): no product.

testSuite.name: TC08_DTI_exactly_50_ARM
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so the ManualReview rule does not apply; ARM criteria met: ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC09_DTI_above_50_conflicts_with_ARM
testSuite.description: DTI 51 triggers ManualReview while all ARM criteria are also met; rules do not state which wins.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) and rule ManualReview (DTI>50) both match; no precedence is stated, expected ManualReview as the more conservative outcome.

testSuite.name: TC10_LTV_exactly_95_no_rule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; variable income prevents ARM and no fixed preference: no product.

testSuite.name: TC11_LTV_above_95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95: ManualReview only.

testSuite.name: TC12_fixed_preference_with_low_credit
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference (Fixed30) and credit 600 (ManualReview) both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) and rule ManualReview (credit<640) both match; no precedence stated, ManualReview or Fixed30 possible; expected ManualReview as the conservative outcome.

testSuite.name: TC13_missing_credit_score
testSuite.description: Credit score is null; ARM needs credit>=720 and ManualReview needs credit<640, neither can be confirmed.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is missing; rules do not state how a null value is handled. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview; expected [] as no rule is confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARM_with_null_sensitivity_and_preference
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity and fixed preference are null (not explicit); ARM criteria fully met: ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC15_LTV_derived_from_collateral
testSuite.description: LTV not provided; derived from loan 180000 over appraised 230000 (78.3%) gives ARM7/1; ambiguous which collateral value is used.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null and must be computed from loan and collateral; rules do not state whether purchasePrice, appraisedValue or the minimum is used. Using appraisal (78.3%) or purchase price (72%) gives ARM7/1; expected ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC16_fixed_preference_and_high_sensitivity_with_ARM_criteria
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference and high sensitivity both lead to Fixed30 while ARM criteria are also met.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true, rateSensitivity=high) and rule ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; no precedence stated, expected Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC17_ARM_zero_horizon_high_credit
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 years (minimum), high credit, low LTV: ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC01_fixed_pref_and_arm_overlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true, but applicant also meets all ARM 7/1 criteria
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference=true) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Expected Fixed30 assumed as first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC02_arm_typical
testSuite.description: Long horizon low sensitivity: no fixed preference, no rule 3 trigger, ARM via rule 2 not met -> ARM7/1 conditions

testSuite.name: TC03_high_sensitivity_fixed
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity alone triggers Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC04_arm_boundary_inclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, stable income, DTI exactly 50 (not over)

testSuite.name: TC05_horizon_just_above_limit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_horizon_eight_no_rule
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years, not stable-hold, no other trigger

testSuite.name: TC07_credit_below_720_no_rule
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 just below ARM threshold, no manual trigger

testSuite.name: TC08_credit_below_640_manual
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_credit_exactly_640_no_rule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC10_dti_over_50_and_arm_overlap
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 while all ARM criteria are met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM 7/1 criteria met) and Rule 3 (DTI>50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Expected ManualReview assumed as the more restrictive outcome.

testSuite.name: TC11_dti_over_50_manual
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 alone triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_dti_exactly_50_no_rule
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not over 50, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC13_ltv_over_95_manual
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_ltv_exactly_95_no_rule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not over 95, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC15_fixed_pref_and_manual_overlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with credit below 640 matches both Fixed30 and manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference=true) and Rule 3 (creditScore<640) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assumed as first-listed rule; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC16_null_credit_score
testSuite.description: Missing credit score: neither ARM (needs >=720) nor manual (needs <640) can be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is treated. Expected no product assumed; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC17_zero_horizon_refinance
testSuite.description: Zero horizon, perfect credit, refinance purpose, ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: TC18_null_income_stability_high_sensitivity
testSuite.description: High sensitivity triggers Fixed30 while null income stability blocks ARM

testSuite.name: TC19_ltv_just_above_80_no_rule
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 blocks ARM 7/1, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC20_ltv_over_95_and_low_credit
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 and credit below 640 both trigger manual review

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">

      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, long horizon, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC02_FixedAndArmConditionsOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and all ARM conditions met at once
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, creditScore>=720) both match; rules do not state precedence. Output Fixed30 assumed by rule order; ARM7/1 is possible.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score within ARM limits

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmCreditScoreBelowThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is just below ARM threshold of 720 and not below 640, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_ManualReviewCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_ManualReviewDtiAboveArmConditions
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 while all ARM conditions are met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions met) and Rule 3 (DTI>50) both match; rules do not state precedence. ManualReview assumed as most likely; ARM7/1 is possible by rule order.

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies with horizon 10

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReviewLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 is above 95, so manual review; ARM not possible due to LTV>80

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedPreferenceWithLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference stated but credit score 600 below 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true) and Rule 3 (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Fixed30 assumed by rule order; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC13_HighSensitivityWithHighLtv
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with LTV 97 above 95
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high) and Rule 3 (LTV>95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Fixed30 assumed by rule order; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC14_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null; ARM and manual review credit conditions cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null: Rule 2 requires creditScore>=720 and Rule 3 requires creditScore<640, neither can be evaluated. Empty result assumed; behavior for missing values is not defined.

testSuite.name: TC15_VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM7/1 assignment

testSuite.name: TC16_HorizonAboveSevenNoArm
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds 7, so ARM7/1 is not assigned

testSuite.name: TC17_ArmWithCashOutRefinance
testSuite.description: Loan purpose refinance_cash_out does not affect ARM7/1 criteria

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedHighCreditLongHorizon
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with excellent credit and long horizon

testSuite.name: TC19_HighSensitivityCreditAbove640
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with credit 650, just above 640 threshold
